description: Email a speaker a follow-up about one outstanding portal task from list_speaker_tasks, with your subject and HTML body. Use it to chase a specific open task; use send_speaker_message for any other note to a speaker. Sends a real external email once it executes. Depending on the organization's settings it runs now or waits for approval; status says which.

eventId.description: Event id, as returned by list_events.

org.description: Organization slug from list_my_orgs; only needed if you belong to several.

request_id.description: Unique id you generate for this write (e.g. a UUID). A retry with the same id returns the first outcome instead of a duplicate; never reuse it for different arguments.

name: send_speaker_reminder

actionId.description: AI activity record id for an executed write.

approvalUrl.description: Where a person approves the pending change, or null.

error.description: Error code and message when status is failed.

message.description: Plain-language note on what happens next.

replayed.description: True when replaying the stored outcome of an earlier call with this request_id.

result.description: The outcome when executed (fields named in the tool description); null when a replay stored none.

status.description: executed: done, see result. pending_approval: awaiting a person; nothing changed yet. executing or failed: an earlier call with this request_id is still running or failed (see error).
